superseded_by.stale_method: heavy-atom, by file order, no superposition
superseded_by.why_withdrawn: this method paired pose and reference heavy atoms strictly by file order without first checking that the two files list the same elements in the same sequence. Here they do not: the pose lists elements C,C,C,C,C,O,O,O,O,C,O,O while the crystal reference lists C,C,C,C,C,C,O,O,O,O,O,O, so file-order pairing matched atoms such as pose O5 against reference C6. The method has been removed from control.py; the current rmsd() only trusts file-order pairing (case 2) after confirming the element sequences match, and otherwise falls back to a same-element nearest-atom lower bound (case 3).
